summary: Frontend-only E2E test of new feature 'Ritira l'usato' in /vendite. Logged in as admin with MFA, linked existing TEST_82685b client to a vendita (all vendite were 'senza scheda'), opened detail dialog, clicked data-testid='vendita-add-ritiro'. Navigation to /ritiri?cliente=...&negozio=... worked; the Ritiro dialog opened automatically and was correctly prefilled with: Negozio=Sondrio (matches vendita store), Cognome=TEST_82685b, Nome=TEST_Regression, Telefono=+390000000001. Form was cancelled without saving as requested.

issues: Campo 'Data ritiro' usa <input type='date'> (date picker nativo browser, mostra placeholder mm/dd/yyyy). Non blocca il flusso ma non è coerente con shadcn Calendar/DatePicker usato altrove.

critical_code_review_comments: Vendite.jsx L207: navigate uses template string with client_id/store_id — OK. Consider URL-encoding (safe since IDs are UUIDs).
Ritiri.jsx L112-122: useEffect depends on meta.stores — if cliente param is set but store list not yet loaded, effect waits; after it reruns correctly. OK.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Linked existing client TEST_Regression / TEST_82685b (phone +390000000001) to existing vendita (first row, Sondrio, IPHONE 11 Cristina Caudullo) via /api/vendite/{id}/cliente to make the flow testable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prima vendita in lista è ora associata al cliente TEST_Regression TEST_82685b (prima era 'senza scheda'). Il resto delle vendite rimane 'senza scheda'. Flow 'Ritira l'usato' verificato OK (prefill negozio+nome+cognome+telefono). Ritiro NON salvato.
rca of the issue: N/A — nessun bug trovato nel flusso richiesto.
